one_line_thesis: Cyclical InP/GaAs substrate supplier recovering from 2023 trough; AI optical demand and Coherent/Casela contracts support mid-cycle normalization, but China/Tongmei complexity, customer concentration, dilution, and negative spot owner cash keep us at watch pending return math.

deep_dive.executive_summary: AXT is a cyclical specialty-substrate supplier levered to InP demand from datacenter and AI optical interconnect markets. FY2025 was a loss year (gross margin 12.7%, operating cash flow −$12.8 million), but Q1 2026 shows revenue acceleration and margin recovery. Recent Coherent and Casela long-term InP supply agreements validate end-market pull. The balance sheet carries $57.9 million in cash and restricted cash at March 31, 2026, partially offset by Tongmei PE redemption rights of roughly $49 million after the STAR Market IPO withdrawal. industry.structure: Specialty compound semiconductor substrates (InP, GaAs, Ge) serve niches where silicon fails; manufacturing is capital-intensive with vertical integration in raw gallium. Industry is oligopolistic but competitive, with China-based cost advantages and export-policy sensitivity.
industry.share_shift: AXT is gaining InP relevance via AI/datacenter optical demand and new supply agreements (Coherent, Casela), but customer concentration (67% top five) shows share is concentrated in a few large buyers rather than broad diversification.
industry.trend: AI-driven high-speed optical interconnect is increasing InP substrate demand; China export controls on specialty materials remain an active regulatory variable. Tongmei's shift from STAR Market to Hong Kong listing reflects evolving China capital-markets access for the operating subsidiary.
